# Step - nearest

`nearest` · category: [Vectors](../../traversal/step_reference.md#vectors)

Exact top-k: the k inputs whose vector property is closest to q, best first.

## Forms

```text
nearest(arg1: any, arg2: any, arg3: i64)
nearest(arg1: any, arg2: any, arg3: i64, arg4: map)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject(#{n: 1, emb: vector([1.0, 0.0])}, #{n: 2, emb: vector([0.0, 1.0])}).nearest("emb", vector([0.0, 1.0]), 1).select("n").next()   // 2
```
